name: Chuuko
source: Whatever Chuko lacks in height she makes up for with her tough personality. She has a fiery temperament, aggressive nature, a whip-like tongue, and isn't afraid of anyone she comes across. She makes quick decisions, moves with purpose, and hates waiting. Chuko may just seem impatient, but is very talented and works hard for the sake of the group. Although she hates spicy food, as it can make her tear up, she will pretend it doesn't bother her just to save face.
